en.headline: Hong Kong rise three places to 153rd in FIFA ranking
en.dek: The latest men's ranking, published on 7 October, puts Hong Kong on 1,035.23 points after a gain credited to the match against Cambodia.
body: Hong Kong's men's team has climbed three places to 153rd in the latest FIFA world ranking, published on 7 October. Radio Television Hong Kong reported the move on Thursday. Spain, Argentina and France occupy the top three places.

Dotdot News, citing Xinhua, said Hong Kong added 3.99 points from the match against Cambodia and now has 1,035.23 points, 30th among Asian Football Confederation teams. Singapore are 149th and Myanmar 159th. Macau are around 193rd.

Hong Kong beat Cambodia 2-0 in the final of the FIFA ASEAN Challenge Cup at Kai Tak Stadium on 3 October, a tournament they hosted as an invited side. The ranking points cited in the reports are tied to that Cambodia result.
The same ranking put the China team down five places to 96th, its lowest position in a decade, on 1,241.90 points. Hong Kong remain 57 places and about 207 points behind.

zh.headline: FIFA排名港隊升3位至第153
zh.dek: 國際足協7日公布最新男足排名，港隊積1035.23分，上升得益於對柬埔寨一仗，港台周四報道有關排名。
body: 中國香港男子足球隊在國際足協最新世界排名升3位，至第153位。排名於10月7日公布，港台周四報道。榜首三位是西班牙、阿根廷及法國。
點新聞引述新華社指，港隊憑對柬埔寨一仗增加3.99分，現積1035.23分，列亞足聯第30位。新加坡排第149，緬甸第159，澳門約第193。
港隊10月3日在啟德體育園主場以2比0擊敗柬埔寨，奪得作為受邀球隊參加的FIFA東盟挑戰盃冠軍。報道所指的積分升幅來自這場對柬埔寨的賽事。
同期中國隊跌5位至第96，積分1241.90，是近十年最低。港隊仍落後57位，積分相差約207分。
